intelligence.enrichment: A single process can include physical changes and chemical changes when some parts only change state while another part forms new substances. In a burning candle, heat first causes wax to melt, move up the wick, and evaporate; the wax vapour then burns and forms new substances. The learner identifies that a burning candle includes physical changes in wax and a chemical change when wax vapour burns to form new substances. A process must be either physical or chemical, so a burning candle cannot be both.
